ForAction.Name: Iteration
ForAction.Description: Repeats a set of actions for a specified number of times or until a condition is met

ConditionalFirstPathAction.Name: Execute first matching path
ConditionalFirstPathAction.Description: Executes only the first path that meets the specified condition

ConditionalAllPathsAction.Name: Execute all matching paths
ConditionalAllPathsAction.Description: Executes all paths that meet the specified condition
